articles.title: Bill Gates' $3.9 million-a-week superyacht has one rule that forces guests off for six hours
articles.standfirst: A dream superyacht, amenities beyond imagination and one unusual feature few would expect to find on a vessel of this caliber.
articles.summary: A dream superyacht, amenities beyond imagination and one unusual feature few would expect to find on a vessel of this caliber.
articles.body:
Imagining a vacation aboard Breakthrough means picturing an experience where seemingly nothing is missing. The 118.8-meter superyacht features ocean-view suites, balconies that extend over the water, a gym, sauna, private cinema and even an underwater lounge with windows offering views of marine life. Everything is designed for an extraordinary luxury getaway, with charter rates reaching $3.9 million per week .

But Breakthrough also has a rather unusual backstory. Its construction was originally commissioned by Bill Gates, Microsoft's co-founder, although he never actually stepped aboard once the superyacht was completed . Some time later, the vessel was acquired by Canadian billionaire Patrick Dovigi, an environmental services entrepreneur and former professional hockey goaltender.

However, beyond the man who commissioned its construction and the impressive amenities it offers, Breakthrough has one particular feature its guests need to keep in mind: whenever it's time to replenish the liquid hydrogen used by one of its power systems, everyone must leave the yacht for approximately six hours. It's a mandatory break that means leaving behind the suites, terraces and all those luxuries to continue the vacation on land.

Why can't anyone stay aboard during refueling?

It all comes down to the fuel used by one of the yacht's power systems. Breakthrough stores approximately four metric tons of liquid hydrogen in a cryogenic tank, which keeps it at a temperature close to -423 degrees Fahrenheit . This fuel requires very specific handling conditions because it can be highly flammable when it comes into contact with oxygen.

That's why refueling isn't an operation that can take place while guests continue enjoying the yacht's facilities. Before the process begins, a safety perimeter is established around the superyacht, and everyone must disembark. From that point on, the operation is handled by specialized personnel.

The process starts with purging the pipes with nitrogen and gradually cooling down the system. Only then does the fuel transfer begin. During this operation, excess gaseous hydrogen is released through a venting structure located on the mast, known as the needle.

So, no matter how much Breakthrough has to offer for an extraordinary vacation, there's one thing even its millions of dollars can't change: when it's time to refuel with hydrogen, everyone has to get off the yacht.

articles.title: Tiffani Thiessen, star of ‘Saved by the Bell,’ will undergo surgery for a hip replacement: “I’m like a German shepherd”
articles.standfirst: The actress shared it on her podcast ‘Breaking Bread with Tom Papa’
articles.summary: The actress shared it on her podcast ‘Breaking Bread with Tom Papa’
articles.body:
Actress Tiffani Thiessen , remembered for her role as Kelly Kapowski in ‘Saved by the Bell’ , revealed in November 2026 that she will have to undergo a hip replacement at age 52 after being diagnosed with hip dysplasia and a labral tear.

She herself revealed the news during her appearance on the podcast ‘Breaking Bread with Tom Papa’ . Initially, she learned that she had a labral tear (the ring of cartilage that surrounds the hip joint). However, after seeking a second medical opinion, she was also diagnosed with hip dysplasia , a condition in which the hip socket does not fully cover the ball-shaped upper part of the femur.

The intense pain has forced the actress to stop playing pickleball

Despite the painful diagnosis, the actress joked that, after learning she has dysplasia, she feels "basically like a German shepherd" , alluding to that dog breed’s well-known predisposition to suffering from this joint problem. “I’ve heard hip replacements aren’t as bad as knee and shoulder replacements” , she said with humor.

Thiessen, who was a dancer in her youth and maintains a very active lifestyle, explained that the intense pain has forced her to stop playing pickleball in recent weeks, a sport she usually plays with her 11-year-old son, Holt. “My doctor didn’t say it was pickleball, but it probably didn’t help. I haven’t been able to play in the last two weeks because my hip was really bad,” she said.

According to outlets such as Fox News and USA Today, the actress commented optimistically that she has heard that recovery from a hip replacement is usually easier than recovery from knee or shoulder surgery.

articles.title: Hoobastank turns FAA ground stop into an impromptu “The Reason” singalong
articles.summary: Hoobastank gave fellow passengers an unexpected live performance during Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop. The band played “The Reason” aboard a Southwest flight as travelers waited during the disruption.
articles.body:
Hoobastank gave fellow passengers an unexpected live performance during Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop. The band played “The Reason” aboard a Southwest flight as travelers waited during the disruption.

Frontman Doug Robb and a guitarist performed an acoustic version of the band’s 2004 hit. Passengers joined in, turning a frustrating travel delay into a plane-wide singalong.

The FAA ordered the ground stop on Nov. 13 after communication issues affected multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers. The agency later lifted the restriction, allowing departures to resume.

Videos of the performance spread on social media, giving travelers a memorable moment amid a day of flight disruptions across the United States.

articles.title: Bertrand Russell, philosopher: “Scientists make the impossible possible, politicians make the possible impossible”
articles.standfirst: A reflection by the British thinker on the differences between science and politics
articles.summary: A reflection by the British thinker on the differences between science and politics
articles.body:
Bertrand Russell was one of the most influential philosophers of the 20th century. A British mathematician, writer and thinker, he devoted much of his life to reflecting on society, knowledge, power and human behavior. His ideas, many of them centered on freedom of thought and critical thinking, continue to attract interest decades after his death.

Among his best-known reflections is a quote that directly contrasts the work of scientists with that of politicians: “Scientists strive to make the impossible possible. Politicians strive to make the possible impossible.” It is an irony-filled observation that highlights two very different ways of confronting challenges.

Science versus the limitations of politics, according to Bertrand Russell

The reflection draws a comparison between those who work to push the boundaries of knowledge and those responsible for managing public affairs. While scientists research, experiment and seek solutions to problems that once appeared to have no answer, politics is portrayed as a realm where obstacles can end up preventing things that should be possible from actually happening.

The quote also invites us to reflect on the expectations placed on public officials. Among politics’ main responsibilities are finding solutions, reaching agreements and enabling progress that benefits society. However, confrontation, competing interests and the difficulty of reaching consensus can become barriers to achieving those goals.

Russell, who died in 1970, championed the importance of reason, intellectual freedom and independent thought throughout his life. His philosophical legacy continues to influence debates on education, democracy and social organization. Through irony, this reflection encapsulates a criticism of the difficulties that can arise when those with the power to change things fail to turn possibilities into realities.

articles.title: Marlon Brando, Actor: "Trust your instincts over anyone else's advice"
articles.standfirst: Marlon Brando's rejection of the Oscar underscores the struggle of aligning personal beliefs with social justice, a challenge that resonates in today's celebrity activism landscape.
articles.summary: Marlon Brando's rejection of the Oscar underscores the struggle of aligning personal beliefs with social justice, a challenge that resonates in today's celebrity activism landscape.
articles.body:
Marlon Brando 's profound influence in cinema continues to resonate today, particularly as we navigate a world marked by hyperconnectivity and the pressures of societal expectations. His work, especially in pieces like Interview, illuminates the struggle of self-discovery, capturing the feeling of being lost amidst overwhelming stimuli and the incessant comparison with others. Brando's insight, "Trust your instincts over anyone else's advice," highlights the importance of personal growth and self-acceptance in an era where external validation often overshadow one’s own values and beliefs.

In contemporary society, the fear of making mistakes and the pressure to adhere to societal norms exacerbate feelings of inadequacy and isolation. Brando's life mirrors these challenges, emphasizing the need for resilience and the value of embracing one's journey, even amidst uncertainty and rapid change. His legacy reminds us that true fulfillment arises not from conformity but from understanding and accepting who we are, a relevant lesson in an age where individuality is constantly challenged by societal benchmarks.

His emphasis on the importance of self-discovery and personal growth aligns with the struggles many face today in pursuing authenticity and direction. Brando’s method acting approach not only revolutionized the film industry but also serves as a poignant reminder of the journey towards understanding one’s true self. By immersing himself deeply in his roles, he highlighted the significance of personal reflection, urging others to embrace their paths of self-exploration and growth.

Marlon Brando: Trusting Instincts in Acting

Marlon Brando, a seminal figure in American cinema, transformed the landscape of acting with his innovative methods and powerful performances. Born on April 3, 1924, in Omaha, Nebraska, Brando rose to stardom in the 1950s through iconic roles in "A Streetcar Named Desire," "On the Waterfront," and "The Godfather." Renowned for his extraordinary talent, he earned multiple awards, including two Academy Awards for Best Actor. Brando's legacy is not only marked by his cinematic achievements but also by his rejection of traditional film norms and advocacy for social justice, particularly noted in his refusal to accept the Oscar for "The Godfather."

Brando's approach to acting, heavily influenced by Stella Adler and the Stanislavski system, emphasized emotional authenticity and immersive character work. His method acting techniques have had a profound impact on generations of actors, shaping the craft as it is understood today. Collaborations with luminaries like Elia Kazan and Tennessee Williams further anchored his significance in the artistic community. The evolution of his career, alongside the works of contemporaries and predecessors, highlights a broader conversation about authenticity in performance—a theme explored by other greats such as Al Pacino and Jack Nicholson, who credit Brando's influence in their own style and approach.

One of Brando’s notable quotes, “Trust your instincts over anyone else's advice,” encapsulates his philosophy of self-trust and authenticity in both acting and personal life. This assertion serves as a powerful reminder of the importance of self-guidance and intuition, particularly in an industry where external opinions are abundant. Brando's own journey, filled with personal struggles and triumphs, reflects the challenges many face when navigating the expectations of society versus the call of one's true self. In essence, his words encourage individuals to find confidence within, drawing a vital connection between self-acceptance and success.

In the 21st century, the relevance of Brando's advice is palpable across various aspects of life. For individuals grappling with career decisions in a fast-paced world, the fear of conforming to others’ expectations can be paralyzing. Embracing Brando’s perspective invites a more introspective approach, urging people to reflect on their instincts instead of yielding to external pressures. This shift not only applies to actors facing the challenges of authenticity but resonates universally, encouraging everyone—from students to professionals— to trust their inner voice in pursuit of their aspirations amidst societal noise.

articles.title: Michael J. Fox and 35 Years of Battling Parkinson's: Here's How He Spent the Evening with His Family at the Gala
articles.standfirst: The actor hosted the 26th edition of his foundation's charity event in New York, accompanied by his wife, Tracy Pollan, and three of his four children.
articles.summary: The actor hosted the 26th edition of his foundation's charity event in New York, accompanied by his wife, Tracy Pollan, and three of his four children.
articles.body:
Michael J. Fox attended the annual gala for his foundation, “A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Cure Parkinson’s,” held at the Waldorf Astoria in New York on Saturday, November 14. The actor, who was diagnosed with Parkinson’s in 1991, was accompanied by his wife, Tracy Pollan, and their daughters Esmé, Aquinnah, and Schuyler.

The family posed together on the red carpet during the 26th edition of the event, organized to raise funds for research into the disease. Fox, 65, and Pollan, whom he has been married to since 1988, spent the evening with guests from the entertainment industry and supporters of the foundation.

Tracy Pollan spoke about life with the actor and his battle with Parkinson’s

During an interview with PEOPLE, Pollan explained how the family copes with the challenges of living with the disease. “I think you just have to take it one day at a time. You have to look at what’s in front of you and stay in the moment. If that moment is okay, that’s where you are,” she said.

The actress also highlighted the work the foundation has done for more than two decades and the importance of the resources allocated to scientists. “We’re really seeing a lot of progress,” she noted, referring to research aimed at improving treatments and finding a cure.

The Michael J. Fox Foundation has already allocated more than $3 billion to research

Fox was diagnosed in 1991, when he was 29, but did not go public with his illness until 1998. In 2000, he founded The Michael J. Fox Foundation , an organization that has since allocated more than $3 billion to fund Parkinson’s research.

This year’s gala featured Denis Leary as host, musical performances by John Mayer and Brad Paisley, and comedy acts by Josh Johnson and Tom Papa. The event marked its 26th edition and brought together people connected to the foundation and scientific research.

In September, Fox had spoken with PEOPLE about the progress he sees in the search for a cure. “We don’t know exactly when it will happen, but it will happen,” he said at the time, with complete conviction. He also mentioned new medications, scientific advances, and tools that help accelerate researchers’ work.

Science is difficult. It’s astronomically expensive. It requires time and collaboration. But as long as we stay focused and hopeful, we’ll get there. And science shows that we’re close. Every year we see more progress in research, new drugs to improve patients’ quality of life, and better tools for scientists to move forward more quickly.

The actor remains committed to leading the organization that bears his name, while continuing to support research into a disease he has been living with for 35 years. The gala on November 14 once again brought together his family and the foundation’s collaborators around that goal.

articles.title: Martin Luther King Jr., Civil Rights activist: "We must accept finite disappointment, but never lose infinite hope"
articles.standfirst: King's plea to his people to never give up remains powerful even over 60 years later
articles.summary: King's plea to his people to never give up remains powerful even over 60 years later
articles.body:
M artin Luther King Jr. believed that setbacks should not prevent people from pursuing a better future, and as the leading voice of the USA 's Civil Rights Movement challenged racial segregation through non-violent protest, insisting that meaningful progress remained possible despite fierce opposition. Born Michael King Jr. on January 15, 1929, in Atlanta, Georgia , he grew up in a religious household shaped by his father's work as a Baptist pastor and King later followed the same vocation, studying at Morehouse College , Crozer Theological Seminary and Boston University , where he earned a doctorate in theology.

He married Coretta Scott , and they raised four children and it was for his children and the wider society that he fought against racism in the United States , with his words, "We must accept finite disappointment, but never lose infinite hope," distilling a belief that setbacks should be acknowledged without surrendering determination. Coming from his 1963 sermon Shattered Dreams , King was not suggesting that people should ignore suffering or expect problems to disappear on their own but rather, he argued that disappointment is an unavoidable part of life, while a person's response can still be shaped by courage and the willingness to keep working towards change. That distinction between accepting reality and giving up is central to the quote as a failed opportunity, personal loss or prolonged struggle can cause genuine pain, but it need not close off every possibility ahead. King applied this principle to individual hardship as well as the fight against systemic injustice.

How did the quote relate to Martin Luther King Jr.'s life?

King 's own career gave weight to the message, becoming a national figure in 1955 after being chosen to lead the Montgomery Bus Boycott , launched following Rosa Parks ' arrest. The protest lasted 382 days, with black residents enduring considerable hardship to challenge segregation on public transport. The boycott contributed to the desegregation of Montgomery 's buses and showed how sustained collective action could force change and inspired by his Christian faith and Mahatma Gandhi 's non-violent philosophy, he continued organizing peaceful resistance despite arrests, threats and intimidation. In Birmingham, Alabama , in 1963, King was imprisoned for taking part in demonstrations against segregation but that did not stop him as from his cell, he wrote the Letter from Birmingham Jail where he rejected calls for African Americans to wait patiently for equality and arguing that injustice required action. Later that year, he addressed approximately 250,000 people at the March on Washington , delivering his historic I Have a Dream speech as his vision of a society where people would be judged by their character rather than skin color gave public expression to the future he was campaigning to achieve. King received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1964 for his leadership of the non-violent Civil Rights Movement . He later widened his activism to include poverty, economic inequality and opposition to the Vietnam War , recognizing that the struggle for justice extended beyond segregation. His life ended when he was assassinated in Memphis on April 4, 1968, aged 39, while supporting striking sanitation workers in Tennessee but the threats and violence he faced never removed his commitment to the cause, although his death showed the terrible personal cost of that work. Ultimately, the message asks people to face disappointment honestly while refusing to let it dictate their future. King understood that progress could be slow and costly; his enduring influence comes partly from showing how conviction can keep individuals and communities moving forward.

articles.body:
Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber have decided to put up for sale the house that their late son Presley owned in the Hollywood Hills for $3.595 million (around €3.26 million) , almost two months after his death. Property records published by TMZ specify the details of the transaction.

The property went on the market on Friday, November 13. It is a mid-century home built in 1955, measuring around 280 square meters , located on a private lot of more than 2,000 square meters. It has four bedrooms, three bathrooms, a heated pool, jacuzzi, sauna, cold plunge area, and a separate guest house. Presley had purchased it in March 2023 for $3.4 million .

Cindy Crawford defines her son: “A sweet and beautiful soul who loved and is loved, now and forever”

Presley Gerber died at the age of 27 last September 20 at the Resolutions Living rehabilitation center (Santa Monica), just one day after being admitted. Police continue to investigate the case as a suspected overdose with no signs of third-party involvement, pending confirmation of the final autopsy results.

After weeks of absolute silence and being seen collecting belongings from that residence, Cindy Crawford and her daughter Kaia shared emotional farewell messages on social media in mid-October, in which the model and actress thanked people for their expressions of affection and remembered her son as “a sweet and beautiful soul who loved and is loved, now and forever” .

For her part, Kaia dedicated this message to her older brother: “I’ve read all the books and I have no answers. My ability to express myself is not up to this , to the magnitude of losing you... I am, literally, on my knees, completely devastated.”

articles.title: Joana Sanz lashes out at Dani Alves after their breakup: "I spent my money paying your bills and your debts"
articles.standfirst: The model has publicly responded to a message from the former footballer in which he claimed that Jesus was the only one who stayed by his side during his most difficult moments
articles.summary: The model has publicly responded to a message from the former footballer in which he claimed that Jesus was the only one who stayed by his side during his most difficult moments
articles.body:
J oana Sanz has responded harshly to Dani Alves after the former footballer posted a message in which he spoke about his religious conversion and claimed that, during his most difficult period, when other people turned their backs on him, Jesus remained by his side. The model used the comments on that post to recall the support that, she says, she gave to the man who was then her husband during his time in prison and to reproach him for having omitted her presence from that account.

"How shameless of you to say publicly that only Jesus stayed ," begins the lengthy comment that Sanz wrote on social media. The model maintains that she kept her pain in the background because she believed that Alves was going through an even worse situation and that she did not want to deny him the emotional support he needed.

"I kept my pain bottled up because I considered that you were in a worse situation and I wasn't capable of denying you that breath of calm that picking up your calls gave you," she explains. She then lists some of the gestures she claims to have had with the former player during those months: prison visits, accompanying him on significant dates, and financial help.

"I visited you despite the whole world collapsing on top of me and having to deal with the media spotlight of headlines that were not mine. I was with you at Christmas when I could have spent it with my family," she recounts. One of the strongest accusations comes when she refers to the money she allegedly used to help him: " I SPENT MY MONEY paying your bills and your debts ".

Dani Alves's message that prompted the response

Sanz's reaction comes after Alves shared a religious testimony in which he reflected on his personal experience and his journey toward faith during his time in prison. The message was spread through a post from an account linked to a worship ministry and later shared on his social media.

There were friends who left . People I trusted who turned their backs on me when I needed them most. But when everyone walked away, Jesus remained ," the former footballer stated. In the same text, he claimed that he had found in his faith the support he had not received from other people: "When others abandoned me, he upheld me. When others doubted me, he stayed with me.

It is precisely that statement that has prompted the public reproach of his ex-partner. Sanz maintains that she stood by his side during that period despite the personal and media consequences it had for her. She also claims that Alves even told her to fend for herself and that it was he who pushed her away .

" You threw me out and I stepped aside to make room for you when you were the last person on the planet who should have received support or kindness," she writes. The model adds that other people in the former footballer's circle did turn their backs on him, while she continued visiting him and helping him.

The comment ends with a new criticism of Alves's attitude: " Me, for whom you never even had to pay for a flight so I could visit you, not once in your life , you repay with public ingratitude. It took me a while to realize it, but better late than never".

A breakup that became known a few days ago

The response comes just a few days after the couple's separation , who married in 2017, became public. Joana Sanz confirmed the distance between them through Instagram and later explained to journalist Javi Hoyos that Alves's new religious life had contributed to driving them apart. According to that information, the model had already begun the divorce proceedings.

The former footballer, who spent 14 months in pretrial detention after being accused of sexual assault at a nightclub in Barcelona, was sentenced in February 2024 to four years and six months in prison. However, the High Court of Justice of Catalonia overturned the conviction in March 2025 and acquitted him, finding that the ruling had not properly assessed certain evidence and that there were doubts about the reliability of the complainant's testimony.

articles.title: Is Dwayne Johnson seriously ill? Viral photos of The Rock spark concern
articles.standfirst: Alarming health claims have sent fans into a frenzy, but the truth behind the viral posts tells a different story
articles.summary: Alarming health claims have sent fans into a frenzy, but the truth behind the viral posts tells a different story
articles.body:
Dwayne Johnson, better known as The Rock, has become the subject of online speculation after photographs showing him with an unusually thin appearance circulated on social media . The images raised questions about his health, with some users suggesting that the actor was dealing with a serious medical condition.

However, the claims quickly spread without any reliable evidence to support them. A post shared on X alleged that Johnson was battling a chronic infection and tuberculosis , while the accompanying photographs appeared to show a dramatic deterioration in his physical condition . The images, however, had been manipulated , and the information about his alleged illnesses was fabricated.

Dwayne Johnson's alleged illness was based on fake photos

The incident highlights how fake social media accounts can use celebrities' names and fabricated stories to attract attention , likes and reposts, sometimes even generating financial benefits from the engagement. These accounts often disregard the potential damage their claims can cause, particularly when they involve someone's health.

The growing use of artificial intelligence has made it increasingly difficult for users to distinguish authentic photographs from manipulated content . In Johnson's case, the altered images were enough to convince some people that something was seriously wrong with the actor , prompting messages of concern and wishes for his recovery.

The Rock's recent weight loss was for a movie role

While the viral claims are false, Johnson has indeed undergone a significant physical transformation. The actor previously revealed that he lost approximately 22 kilograms (48.5 pounds) over the course of a year to prepare for his upcoming project, Lizard Music, directed by Benny Safdie.

According to the original report published by BollywoodShaadis , Johnson explained that his training routine , diet and conditioning played an important role in the transformation. He also shared that his weight currently sits between 232 and 235 pounds (105-106 kilograms), while emphasizing that he has maintained his strength, endurance and cardiovascular fitness.

There is no verified information indicating that The Rock is suffering from tuberculosis or a chronic infection . Although his changing physique has attracted attention, the viral photographs and accompanying health allegations should not be mistaken for evidence of an illness, especially when the photographs have been manipulated.

articles.title: Emily Ratajkowski turns heads with a standout look at her best friend's bachelorette party
articles.standfirst: The model joined a very special celebration, but one accessory in her photos sparked some unexpected curiosity.
articles.summary: The model joined a very special celebration, but one accessory in her photos sparked some unexpected curiosity.
articles.body:
Emily Ratajkowski traded the runways and photoshoots for a night out with one of the most important people in her life. Her best friend is getting ready to tie the knot, and the model wanted to be there to celebrate her bachelorette party, a special occasion she also shared with her Instagram followers. “my best friend is getting marrieeeeddddd!!!!”

Emily Ratajkowski puts a cowboy spin on her party look

For the celebration, Emily opted for a black outfit featuring sparkly straps and dark pants . However, her accessories gave the ensemble a distinctive twist: a red cowboy hat and white heart-shaped sunglasses that added a playful touch to her look.

In another photo, she posed alongside her best friend as the two held drinks. The decorations also made an appearance, with several white balloons scattered across the floor, giving the venue a festive yet intimate atmosphere without the need for elaborate decorations .

Emily Ratajkowski's 'Bride' hat raises questions

But among all the photos, one detail deserves a closer look. Emily also posed wearing a white hat with the word “Bride” written across it , the traditional accessory often worn by the bride during bachelorette celebrations.

And here's the curious part: the model wasn't the one getting married. She was there to celebrate her best friend. So why was she wearing the bride's accessory? The photos offered no explanation, but the contrast between the message on the hat and the reason for the party added an unexpected twist to her post.

articles.body:
Abraham Lincoln's leadership during the Civil War is a testament to his profound understanding of purpose and goals, as reflected in his famous quote: “When I do good, I feel good. When I do bad, I feel bad. That's my religion.” In today's world, where anxiety about the future and fear of making mistakes plague many, his emphasis on maintaining unity amidst crisis is particularly relevant. The challenges of life lacking direction are amplified by the fast pace of modern society, leaving individuals feeling lost and overwhelmed.

Moreover, Lincoln's commitment to emancipation highlights the ongoing struggle for civil rights and social justice. As society grapples with issues of inequality and dependence on others' opinions, his legacy serves as a reminder of the importance of self-acceptance and the relentless pursuit of equality. In a time characterized by heightened individualism and consumption, reconnecting with the values of moral leadership and unity remains crucial for navigating contemporary challenges.

Leadership and Moral Integrity in Abraham Lincoln's Philosophy

Abraham Lincoln, the 16th President of the United States, is recognized as a pivotal figure in American history due to his leadership during the Civil War and his commitment to abolishing slavery. Born on February 12, 1809, in a humble setting in Kentucky, Lincoln's journey from a self-taught lawyer to a national leader exemplifies the American Dream. His presidency was marked not only by the turmoil of the Civil War but also by his eloquent speeches, including the notable Gettysburg Address, which articulated his vision for a unified nation founded on principles of equality and democracy.

Lincoln's intellectual legacy profoundly influences contemporary discussions about civil rights and leadership. His actions, especially the Emancipation Proclamation, defined his moral stance; he believed that unity and freedom were essential for the nation’s survival. His approach to leadership during crises resonates with ideas of other influential figures, such as Martin Luther King Jr., who also advocated for equality and justice. By emphasizing the importance of effective communication and moral integrity, Lincoln established a framework for navigating social and political challenges that remains relevant in today’s debates around civil rights and political ideology.

One of Lincoln's significant quotes, "When I do good, I feel good. When I do bad, I feel bad. That's my religion," reflects his deep understanding of ethics and moral responsibility. This statement encapsulates his belief that personal integrity and leadership are intertwined. In a time of division, he sought to unify the nation by adhering to a moral compass that prioritized the well-being of others. His persistent focus on doing good serves as a guiding principle for leaders seeking to cultivate trust and foster resilience within their communities.

In today's world, this sentiment holds considerable importance. Imagine a typical day in the 21st century, where individuals often face ethical dilemmas in various aspects of life—at work, in social interactions, or within their communities. Lincoln's philosophy underscores the significance of acting with integrity and purpose. By making conscious choices that prioritize the greater good, individuals can navigate complexities and foster positive relationships, much like Lincoln did during his presidency. His encouragement to align actions with ethical beliefs remains a guiding light for cultivating unity and morale amid the challenges faced in contemporary society.

Hannah Arendt, in her work The Human Condition, argues that "promise is the only way to master the unpredictable future." This idea resonates today in a world characterized by hyperconnectivity and work pressure , where uncertainty and the speed of daily life create an atmosphere of anxiety. Political polarization and desensitization to injustice are everyday phenomena that evoke her analysis of the banality of evil, warning of how a lack of reflection can lead to complacency in the face of alarming situations.

Individualism and the excess of stimuli offered by today's technology exacerbate individuals' alienation from the political sphere, a theme that Arendt explored when discussing totalitarianism. Distrust in politicians and parties is a reflection of this crisis of citizen participation , which makes her ideas about political pluralism and personal responsibility especially relevant, by encouraging critical thinking that counteracts authoritarianism and fosters committed political action.

The promise as the master of the unpredictable future

Hannah Arendt, a German-American philosopher, historian, and political theorist, is recognized for her profound analysis of totalitarianism and the human condition. Born in 1906 into a secular Jewish family, Arendt lived in a context marked by the political upheavals of her time , which influenced her critical thought. Her most influential work, "The Origins of Totalitarianism," examines the mechanisms of Nazism and Stalinism, establishing a fundamental reference point in the study of authoritarian regimes. Throughout her life, Arendt maintained a commitment to social justice and human rights, contributing a legacy that continues to resonate in contemporary thought.

Arendt's thought is framed by the struggle against totalitarianism and the defense of political pluralism, emphasizing the importance of diversity of opinions as the essence of freedom and equality. Her theory of the "banality of evil" is crucial to understanding how ordinary people can come to commit atrocities when they act without reflecting on their actions . Likewise, her critique of representative democracy and her advocacy for a more participatory democracy portray her desire for political reinvention in response to the conditions of the 20th century. Her relationship with other authors, such as Martin Heidegger and Karl Jaspers, also underscores her contribution to the philosophical debate on human action and ethics.

articles.standfirst: The search for identity and refuge can help us find purpose, especially in the face of the refugee crisis, through Khaled Hosseini's reflection on Afghan culture
articles.summary: The search for identity and refuge can help us find purpose, especially in the face of the refugee crisis, through Khaled Hosseini's reflection on Afghan culture
articles.body:
Khaled Hosseini is an Afghan-American writer whose work reflects the depth of Afghan culture and universal human dilemmas. In his famous novel "The Kite Runner" , he addresses the search for identity and meaning in a contemporary world marked by hyperconnectivity and social pressure.

Uncertainty and the fear of making mistakes are recurring themes in his narratives . Hosseini invites us to reflect on the fear of failure and the need to learn from mistakes. These issues are present in today’s reality, where individualism and hyperproductivity affect our ability to establish genuine connections. Thus, his work not only sheds light on the tensions of the past, but also resonates with the struggles of the present, reminding us of the importance of facing our fears and seeking authenticity in a world full of stimuli.

Khaled Hosseini and his literary influence

Khaled Hosseini, born on March 4, 1965, in Kabul, Afghanistan, is an Afghan-American writer and physician recognized for his novels that reflect Afghan culture and people. His work, which includes books such as "The Kite Runner" and "A Thousand Splendid Suns," has had a significant impact on contemporary literature, contributing to a better understanding of the history and challenges faced by Afghanistan. His authority on the subject is based not only on his literary success, but also on his personal experience as an immigrant and humanitarian activist.

Hosseini's ideas focus on cultural representation, identity, and migration . His work is characterized by a profound exploration of human relationships, suffering, and the search for redemption, themes that are intertwined with the experiences of his own life. Following the literary tradition of authors such as Rumi and Jack London, Hosseini addresses the complexity of cultural identity and the impact of war on childhood. His narrative not only offers visibility to the rich Afghan culture, but also echoes a universal struggle for understanding and empathy in times of conflict.

articles.title: Louis Dumur, writer: “Politics is the art of making use of men by making them believe that they are being served”
articles.standfirst: The Franco-Swiss man speaks openly about the use of illusion in power
articles.summary: The Franco-Swiss man speaks openly about the use of illusion in power
articles.body:
Politics has been present in the lives of human beings for thousands of years. Despite this connection, the development of democracies and penal reforms, the truth is that those who devote their time to power assume that, for a large majority, politicians do not act for the common good, but for their own benefit , both on a personal level and in economic terms.

Louis Dumur , a writer and journalist of Franco-Swiss origin, once said: “Politics is the art of making use of men by making them believe that they are being served.” A phrase that portrays representatives of the citizenry as people who follow a strategy aimed at manipulating society in order to turn any act into something that serves the whole.

The art of deception through politics

Only those who practice politics skillfully know how to carry out this idea: the politician must deceive citizens into believing that he works for them , when in reality he acts to achieve what he sets out to do at society’s expense and without it realizing the truth.

For Dumur, who said this in his work ‘Petits Aphorismes’ , politics is an art of persuasion, in which rhetoric must be mastered with the aim of securing the necessary votes ahead of an election . Politics plays a fundamental role in achieving this in a legal manner, through voting and approved legal processes.

Dumur was one of the many thinkers who did not trust human nature and stood out for putting an end to political idealism through his reflections, achieving a prominent role in Paris from the late 19th century and early 20th century , coming to be considered by many as a reference on the level of Edmond Thiaudière.

articles.title: Epicurus, Greek philosopher: "It is impossible to live a pleasant life without living wisely and honorably and justly..."
articles.standfirst: The ancient Greek philosopher believed genuine happiness was not found through wealth or endless indulgence
articles.summary: The ancient Greek philosopher believed genuine happiness was not found through wealth or endless indulgence
articles.body:
The Ancient Greek philosopher Epicurus believed happiness was far less complicated than many people make it as more than 2300 years ago, he argued that a satisfying life depended not on wealth or status - but on wisdom, fairness and the ability to recognize what truly matters. Born on the island of Samos in 341 BC, Epicurus became one of the defining thinkers of the Hellenistic age, and his philosophy placed pleasure at the center of human life, although his understanding of pleasure was far removed from endless indulgence or the pursuit of luxury.

After studying and teaching in several Greek cities, Epicurus settled in Athens around 306 BC and founded a school known as the Garden as it offered a distinctive community where students could discuss ideas and pursue knowledge beyond the usual barriers of wealth, status and gender. Even women and enslaved people were welcomed into the Garden , an unusual feature in the society of the time and he valued the bonds formed there, believing friendship offered security and contentment while helping people live without the anxieties created by competition and public ambition. His thinking is captured in one of his best-known statements as Epicurus said, "It is impossible to live a pleasant life without living wisely and honorably and justly, and it is impossible to live wisely and honorably and justly without living pleasantly." The words reveal how closely he connected happiness with character as Epicurus did not mean that people should pursue every pleasure available to them. Some enjoyments, he reasoned, bring pain or difficulty later, while restraint and temporary discomfort can lead to greater peace. Wisdom involves judging those consequences rather than simply following the strongest immediate desire whilst honor and justice were equally important to his understanding of a good life as a person could not claim to be truly happy while behaving dishonestly or causing harm to others.

Why Epicurus' quote remains relevant today

Pleasure, in his view, was inseparable from living responsibly and maintaining relationships built on trust and that remains true even in modern life, which often encourages people to measure achievement through salary, possessions, career recognition and social standing. Epicurus offers a different test: whether the choices people make bring lasting peace and fulfilment, or simply feed desires that become harder to satisfy and his emphasis on wisdom can apply to everyday decisions about money, work and relationships. Immediate gratification may feel rewarding, but choices made without considering their consequences can create lasting stress. A more considered approach asks whether a pleasure is worth the cost it may bring. The philosopher's insistence on honor and justice also challenges the idea that success should be pursued at any price as personal advancement means less if it depends on exploiting others or abandoning principles, and a satisfying life, Epicurus suggests, must account for how our actions affect the people around us.

articles.title: The detail in Taylor Swift's necklaces that drove fans crazy during the Grammy announcement. Is there a connection to Pixar?
articles.standfirst: The singer made an unexpected appearance in the announcement of the 2027 Grammy nominations, but her accessories ended up stealing some of the spotlight. Fans believe there is a new "hidden clue" related to Toy Story 5.
articles.summary: The singer made an unexpected appearance in the announcement of the 2027 Grammy nominations, but her accessories ended up stealing some of the spotlight. Fans believe there is a new "hidden clue" related to Toy Story 5.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift once again proved that her followers don't miss a single detail of her public appearances. This time, the reason for the speculation was two gold necklaces she wore during a surprise appearance on the Recording Academy broadcast, in which the nominations for the 2027 Grammy Awards. were announced.

Although her appearance was intended to present the nominees for Album of the Year and Song of the Year, Swifties quickly shifted their attention to the jewelry she was wearing around her neck. The theory that began to circulate points to a connection with Toy Story 5 and with one of the songs the artist wrote for the film.

The two pieces of jewelry that sparked Swifties' theories

One of the necklaces has a horseshoe decorated with diamonds, while the second features a pendant shaped like a horse. For Taylor's followers, both accessories could be a direct reference to Jessie, the cowgirl from the Pixar franchise, and her inseparable horse Bullseye.

The connection doesn’t seem accidental. Swift wrote and performed "I Knew It, I Knew You ", a song included on the Toy Story 5 soundtrack and inspired by Jessie. In addition, the track earned a nomination for Song of the Year at the upcoming Grammys.

When the singer released the song composed for the Pixar film, she stated:

Writing this song felt like a musical outlet and a return home at the same time. Creating something for Jessie was a new challenge, and it also felt natural at the same time. And being a kid from age 5 until now... it's an adventure I plan to be on, to infinity and beyond

Taylor had already worn that necklace before revealing her collaboration with Pixar

What makes the theory even more interesting is that the singer had worn the same diamond horseshoe months before her involvement in the film was announced. She first appeared wearing it during an outing in New York in April 2026, and later showed it off again at the Toy Story 5 premiere in June. For fans, it could have been one of the early clues so characteristic of the artist.

The appearance also coincided with an important professional moment: The Life of a Showgirl received a nomination for Album of the Year, while "I Knew It, I Knew You" will compete for Song of the Year. Taylor thus earns her eighth nomination in the Album of the Year category and continues to expand her track record at the awards.

Once again, an apparently simple accessory ended up becoming the center of a conversation among her followers. And although Taylor did not explain the meaning of the two necklaces during the broadcast, Swifties have already found a possible answer in the Toy Story universe.

articles.title: The police ruled out foul play, but Hayden Panettiere's mother insists that her ex, Brian Hickerson, is to blame for her death: Here's why
articles.standfirst: Hayden Panettiere's mom reveals why she blames Brian Hickerson and skipped her daughter's memorial
articles.summary: Hayden Panettiere's mom reveals why she blames Brian Hickerson and skipped her daughter's memorial
articles.body:
Hayden Panettiere's mother, Lesley Vogel , isn't backing down from her controversial claims about the actress's former boyfriend, Brian Hickerson, despite authorities officially ruling her daughter's death accidental.

In a new interview with Inside Edition, Vogel opened up about her belief that Hickerson was responsible for the circumstances surrounding Panettiere's final months.

She maintained that she'd worked hard to help her daughter turn her life around before the actress became involved with him again. Asked directly whether she believed Hickerson was to blame, Vogel didn't hesitate.

"Absolutely, there's no doubt in my mind," she told host Eva Pilgrim . “I had done everything to try to clean up her life, in the end, and I thought we were making amazing progress.

"It was going very well. And then, sadly, she allowed Brian to reel her back in."

The actress, best known for her roles in Heroes and Nashville, had reportedly been experiencing significant physical difficulties alongside her personal struggles. Vogel previously described taking her daughter to medical appointments and arranging massage and acupuncture treatments after she complained of pain and tingling sensations in her legs.

She also recalled feeling increasingly concerned about her daughter's condition, claiming Panettiere was struggling physically and emotionally during that difficult period.

Why Vogel stayed away from her daughter's memorial

Vogel also addressed another emotional decision: her absence from Panettiere's September 19 celebration of life.

Although she confirmed receiving an invitation, she ultimately decided against attending because she feared her presence might create additional tension among family members and guests.

“I knew that some of the people there wanted to believe that I’m the horrible mother, because Hayden was angry and made statements,” Vogel said.

“I just didn’t want to rock the boat either. It was probably for the best.”

Their relationship had reportedly been strained for years, with Panettiere discussing their complicated family dynamic in her May 2026 memoir, This Is Me: A Reckoning. The actress had previously expressed hope that they might eventually repair their relationship, despite their estrangement.

In an earlier interview, Panettiere acknowledged that she and her mother weren't speaking but made it clear she hadn't completely closed the door on reconciliation. She also spoke positively about her relationship with her father, Alan "Skip" Panettiere.

Meanwhile, authorities have reached a different conclusion regarding the circumstances of her death. Panettiere died on August 16, aged 36, at an apartment in Greenville, South Carolina.

The Greenville County Coroner's Office determined that the actress died from the toxic effects of fentanyl, 4-ANPP, alprazolam, methocarbamol and quetiapine. Her death was classified as accidental, and the autopsy found no evidence of contributing physical trauma.

Greenville police subsequently announced on October 28 that their investigation had concluded, with no charges filed against Hickerson in connection with her death.
